verdict.rationale: Ashby documents a report builder for custom reports, and its documented API offers paginated list endpoints with sync tokens for incremental application pulls, which is a viable way to extract data to a warehouse. However, nothing in the pack shows scheduled report exports, BI or warehouse connectors, or an API that returns the custom reports themselves. missing for 10: scheduled exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a reporting-specific API exposing custom report output, independent corroboration of data extraction.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse

citations.quote: out of the box reports, customizable templates, and a report builder to build your own from scratch
A sync token to retrieve only applications updated since the last sync.
Some endpoints are paginated, and, optionally take an opaque "cursor" to indicate the page of results to fetch.
